Class HoldDailyTotal

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.entities.HoldDailyTotal
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPeriodHolding
@Entity public class HoldDailyTotal extends Object implements IPeriodHolding
The total value of a tenant or of one of its portfolios at the close of one trading day: securities plus cash balance plus the result of the closed margin positions, together with every other figure of the period performance.

There is one row per trading day for each portfolio, in the portfolio currency, and one for the tenant with idPortfolio null, in the tenant currency. The rows are copies of what HoldSecurityaccountSecurity.getPeriodHoldingsByTenant / ...ByPortfolio deliver for that day, so they match the period performance report by construction. A day the report cannot value completely, because a quote or an exchange rate is missing, has no row either. They exist so that a consumer needing the value of many days, such as a chart or a fee model graded by the total assets, does not have to run that query each time.

The task HOLD_DAILY_TOTAL_UPDATE is the only writer: it deletes a range of days and inserts it again in one transaction. That is why there is no unique key, which MariaDB would not enforce for a null idPortfolio anyway. From which day the rows of a tenant may be missing or outdated is kept in HoldDailyTotalState.

The table is derived data and deliberately not part of an ExportDefinition: after an import the tenant has no HoldDailyTotalState row, which makes the task compute its whole history again. Deleting the tenant or a portfolio removes the rows through the foreign key cascades. No entity limit applies, because nothing but the task writes it.

      public double getMarginCloseGainMC()
      Description copied from interface: IPeriodHolding
      Open result of the margin positions on the date, in MC: holdings × split_price_factor × (price − margin_average_price / split_price_factor) × exchange rate. It is complementary to IPeriodHolding.getSecuritiesMC(), which contains only positions without a margin average price, and is therefore part of the total value of the day.

    • getSecurityRiskMC

      public double getSecurityRiskMC()
      Description copied from interface: IPeriodHolding
      Security risk of the positions on the date, in MC: the market value of every held position, margin positions at their full exposure, multiplied by the leverage factor of the instrument. It is the same figure as the security risk of the security account reports, so a leveraged or inverse instrument contributes with its factor.

    • getExternalCashTransferMC

      public double getExternalCashTransferMC()
      Description copied from interface: IPeriodHolding
      Cumulative external cash transfers (deposits less withdrawals) up to and including the date, in MC. It is a level, not the flow of the day: it sums the deposit column of hold_cashaccount_deposit over the rows valid on that date, so the flow between two dates is the difference of their values.
      Specified by:
      getExternalCashTransferMC in interface IPeriodHolding

    • getFeeRealMC

      public double getFeeRealMC()
      Description copied from interface: IPeriodHolding
      Cumulative realized fees from the account's first transaction up to and including this date, converted to the relevant currency (MC). The query negates the sum, so a cost is delivered as a positive value. It contains the separately booked account and depot fees alone. The trading costs contained in a purchase or sale are part of IPeriodHolding.getAccumulateReduceMC(), and the financing costs of margin positions are reported through the securities result; neither is here, so this figure covers the same bookings as the fee column of the cash account summary.

      Like every cumulative column of this projection except the external cash transfers, the running total is kept in the cash account's own currency and revalued once with the currency-pair close of the reporting day. The cash account summary converts each booking with the rate of its own date instead, so the two figures differ for foreign-currency accounts by the currency movement since the bookings were made.

      Specified by:
      getFeeRealMC in interface IPeriodHolding
